name: Deshi Shahi Cow
description: Healthy deshi cow suitable for Qurbani. Well fed with natural food. Strong and active animal raised in open field.

name: Brahman Bull
description: Premium Brahman bull with excellent body structure. Ideal for Qurbani with heavy weight and healthy condition. Vaccinated and dewormed.

name: Australian Sheep
description: Pure Merino sheep imported breed, very calm and healthy. Suitable for Qurbani and wool production. Raised on green grass and hay.

name: Black Bengal Goat
description: Famous Black Bengal goat — the pride of Bangladesh. High quality meat and very healthy. Perfect for Qurbani and daily farming.

name: Jamuna Pari Goat
description: Originating from the Etawah district of Uttar Pradesh, the Jamuna Pari is often considered the majestic breed of the Indian goat world. It is a dual-purpose breed, valued for both its high milk yield and meat.

name: Hariana Cow
description: The Hariana is a premier dual-purpose cattle breed from North India (specifically Haryana and parts of Punjab and Rajasthan). It is the backbone of many traditional agricultural households.

name: Deshi Khashi
description: Local deshi khashi (castrated goat) with tender and tasty meat. Ideal for family Qurbani. Naturally raised without any hormones.

name: Friesian Cross Cow
description: Holstein Friesian crossbreed with massive body weight. Top choice for large Qurbani. Raised in a modern farm with balanced diet and regular vet checkups.
